declared_at: 2026-10-06, BEFORE any Analysis-A number was computed; not tuned afterwards. Any later change is logged under 'post_hoc' in metrics.json.
naming: 'Dalio Holy Grail' = Dalio's diversification framework. 'Composer HG symphony' = Casey's 3x-momentum Composer strategy. Never conflated in any label.
book: books/casey-2026-10.yaml, loaded with holygrail.book.book_from_dict; variants are in-memory edits of the parsed YAML (totals re-declared so reconciliation still runs). The book file is NOT modified.

estimation_base.annualisation: engine infer_periods_per_year on the common calendar
estimation_base.calendar: engine active-intersection daily calendar (crypto weekends compound into Monday)

estimation_robustness.R1_longest_common: daily, lw_cc, every row where all streams of the view have data, ending 2026-09-30 (window_years 20)
estimation_robustness.R2_weekly: weekly (W-FRI), lw_cc, trailing 3y: checks asynchronous closes (China/Mexico/crypto)

composer_series: IN-SAMPLE backtest levels (data/casey/composer_<slug>_backtest.csv) before each symphony's live start, then LIVE deposit-adjusted returns from the live start (hg 2025-12-05, kmlm 2026-07-07, crash 2026-07-07, vixhyg 2026-07-22). Robustness: backtest only. Composer is NOT called in this analysis (cached files only; read-only rule).

expected_returns.base: NEUTRAL PRIOR, Dalio/Bridgewater: every risky market/series stream mu = rf + 0.30 x its base-window vol (Dalio 2026 '.3'; Bridgewater ETRR 2011 betas 'Sharpe 0.2 to 0.3'; RPAB stocks 0.24 / bonds 0.28)
expected_returns.alpha_haircut: Sharpe 0 for Composer symphonies, single names and BTC (Bridgewater ETRR: alphas 'slightly negative on average'), betas at 0.30
expected_returns.cash: BOXX/BIL/cash at rf (FRED DTB3 latest); HL USDC 0%
expected_returns.parametric: book assumptions unchanged (loans: coupon less expected default; ETH carry: trailing funding; private assets rf + 0.30 x stated vol)
expected_returns.rule: every return-dependent number is labelled PRIOR-DRIVEN; results that do not depend on mu (vol, risk shares, N_eff, environment balance) are shown first

views.whole_at_mark: book view 'investable' = sheet net worth minus the 3 RECON (not-an-asset) lines; Organics Ocean at $12.0M
views.whole_oo_10m_15m_20m: same with Organics Ocean position set to $10M / $15M / $20M
views.investable_ex_oo: investable view with the Organics Ocean position removed
views.liquid_now: book view 'liquid' ($2,485,346): Composer looked through to its 4 symphonies (holdings-level look-through impossible: holdings rotate daily)
views.liquid_post_revert: liquid view with the 16% loans ($310,876.30) moved to BOXX

environment_mapping: engine stream_box_mapping: manual 'environments' first (BTC growth_up+inflation_up; Composer Crash Convexity growth_down; Composer VIX Harvester growth_up; real estate growth_up+inflation_up), else engine CANONICAL_MAP by asset_class (Bridgewater 2012). New streams: TLT nominal_bond, TIP ilb, DBC commodity, ALLW-replica all four boxes (manual, by construction), core/gold/single-name/momentum composites by their asset class. KMLM, ETH carry and cash have no canonical box: reported as unmapped.

A3_A4.corr_basis: base-window daily stream correlations from the engine Moments (weekly R2 alongside)
A3_A4.rest_of_book: corr(stream, liquid-book-ex-stream) = (S w_-i)_i / (sigma_i sigma(w_-i)) using liquid_post_revert weights
A3_A4.downside: mean daily return on SPY's worst 5% days in the base window (empirical streams only)

funding_rule: every buy draws BOXX first, then the 'Cash/stables ex-Hyperliquid' and U26 cash lines, then a margin loan (liability cash stream at rf + spread); every sale goes to BOXX

A5_moves.M0: 16% loans revert to BOXX: +$310,876 BOXX (scheduled, not a decision)
A5_moves.M4: trim single names: sell half of TSLA, FTZFF and SHAZ
A5_moves.M5: cap BTC: sell $139,400 of the sheet BTC position (half)
A5_moves.M6: Composer as ONE equity-momentum budget: cut HG symphony + KMLM switcher pro rata from $184,300 to $120,000; +$30,000 to Crash Convexity
A5_moves.M8: gear the balanced core 1.5x: equity beta (SPY/AVUV/AVDV/AVEM/QUAL) + TLT + TIP + DBC positions x1.5 (margin/futures funded after cash)
A5_moves.M9_alternative: +$250,000 ALLW, modelled as a replica composite of its 2026-10-05 published exposures (nominal bonds 69.50% -> IEF, equities 43.65% -> SPY 25/EFA 12/VEIEX 6.65, ILB 41.19% -> TIP, commodities 32.69% -> DBC; gross 1.87x; fee 0.85%; embedded financing spread 0.30%); one-at-a-time only, NOT in the cumulative path (alternative to M1-M3)
A5_moves.order: one at a time from liquid_now; cumulatively M0 -> M8
outputs: PRIOR-DRIVEN exp return now and at 15% (IBKR spread)

core_streams.gold_silver: physical metals + PHYS + PSLV at current $ mix (box: inflation_up)

A6_proposed.core_split: engine allocate.quadrant_balance on the core sub-covariance (25% of core risk per box, canonical map); core budgets = 0.60 x those
A6_proposed.solve: engine allocate.risk_budget_weights on the full budgeted covariance, then one scalar L (bisection) so total ex-ante vol incl. fixed sleeves = 15.0%; cash = 1 - sum(w); negative cash = margin loan at rf + spread; gross cap 3.0x
A6_proposed.financing_spread_basis: IBKR Pro USD blended for a ~$1M loan: first $100k at 5.380%, next $900k at 4.880% => 4.93%, minus DTB3 4.01% = 0.92% (ibkr.com margin-rates page fetched 2026-10-06)
routes: futures (equity index implied financing over SOFR; Treasury futures implied repo)
levered balanced ETFs (ALLW, UPAR, RSSB): fee + embedded futures financing

BT_A_real_data.window: common window of every proposed+current stream, real data only (no proxies beyond the book's declared ARKG/BOTZ/IREN), to 2026-09-30
BT_A_real_data.current: liquid_post_revert weights held constant, rebalanced monthly (HINDSIGHT: today's mix replayed)
BT_A_real_data.proposed: walk-forward: window 252 days, min 252, lw_cc, monthly rebalance at the close, re-solved budgets + gearing each month (start_when all)

BT_B_long_backfilled.replica_backfill: every other stream before its first real return: r = beta' f, f = daily [SPY, TLT, GLD, DBC] returns, beta = OLS on WEEKLY returns over the stream's full real history to 2026-09-30, no intercept, no residual (idiosyncratic risk NOT backfilled)
BT_B_long_backfilled.eth_carry: constant accrual at its book expected return (no history)

books: liquid_now (loans as BOXX-like cash in replay)
stress.method: engine forward.replay_scenario on the BT_B panel, buy-and-hold from the scenario start, borrowing pays DTB3 (spread not charged: windows <= 17 months)
stress.label: share of each book's weight that is replica/proxy in each window is reported

forward.method: engine run_forward bootstrap (stationary block), WEEKLY returns of the BT_B panel 2006-05..2026-09, mean block 8 weeks, 10 years, 10,000 paths, seed 20261006
forward.recentring: each stream's weekly history is demeaned and re-centred on its PRIOR mean (rf_now + 0.30 x vol; cash rf_now) so in-sample means (e.g. Composer backtest CAGRs) do not drive the result; shape (vol clustering within blocks, fat tails, co-movement) is IN-SAMPLE
